arrive.text: A hilltop, in the fog. Five of you, and none of you knows who you are.

veil.text: When the veil lifts, you'll each be born into the town that's chosen here. Rich or poor, lucky or not. You won't know which until then.

towns.text: On the table, three towns. The numbers are what each house will have.

town_1.text: In the first town, everyone has the same. Five each.

town_2.text: In the second, most have very little, and one has a fortune. On average, it's the richest town of the three.

town_3.text: In the third, some have more than others. But even the least well off have more than anyone in the first town.

ask.text: Which town will you choose, not knowing who you'll be?

others_chose.text: You don't choose. So the others do. And the veil lifts.

eq_1.text: Everyone has the same. So do you.

eq_2.text: Nobody was left with less. Nobody could have more, either.

g_mid.text: A good house. Not the best, but better than most.

g_poor.text: One of the small houses. It was always the likeliest place to land.

g_2.text: On average, this was the richest town. But nobody lives an average life.

r_low.text: One of the smallest houses. Still more than anyone has in the first town.

r_mid.text: Not the biggest house, and not the smallest.

r_2.text: You chose the town where the worst place to land was as good as it could be.
